skills.name: Torrential Blade (湍刃/怒涛の刃)
skills.line: The far sea is my home.
skills.description: Taki conjures a torrential blade to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Torrential Shelter (涛泷之佑/瀧の守り)
skills.line: Special care from the Golden Tentacles.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
Taki grants himself 1 Alert stack, plus 1 additional Alert stack for each 50% of initial Crit he has. ;Alert (戒备/警戒) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 4 stacks. If he doesn't have Taki's Pact, 1 stack is removed to initiate Taki's Pact. Triggers when an ally receives crit damage. Each stack decreases the attacker's Crit DMG by 40% (cannot exceed 80% of the their initial Crit DMG). Has no effect on monsters. ;Taki's Pact (泷之契/瀧の契) : :'''Buff, Mark''': A undispellable shield that can absorb a damage equal to 10% of his initial max HP.

upgrades.text: Initial Crit required to gain additional Alert stacks decreases to 40%.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically starts battle with 4 Alert stacks.
For each Alert stack he has, increases Sweeping Moment's damage multiplier by 100%.

skills.name: Taki's Sweeper (泷之决荡/激動の瀧)
skills.line: Show them what you've got, Hizz.
skills.description:
Don't try to play tricks on my crew.
Taki grants Convoy to another ally, lasts for 2 turns. Then triggers Sweeping moment, dealing true damage to all enemies equal to 150% of his initial DEF. Only 1 ally can be Convoyed at a single time. The damage does not trigger his soul effect. ;Convoy (护航/航行護衛) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Decreases the onibi cost for the ally's skills by 1. When the ally doesn't use onibi on their turn, and if Taki is not Inflicted with a control effect, triggers Sweeping Moment, dealing true damage to all enemies equal to 150% of Taki's initial DEF. The damage can only be triggered once each turn.

upgrades.text: Sweeping Moment no longer triggers enemy souls.
When the ally with Convoy uses a special skill, increases Taki's move bar by 15%.
Sweeping Moment no longer triggers enemy passives.
When the ally with Convoy uses a special skill, decreases their skills' onibi cost by 2.

bio.condition: With Taki win 30 times in PVN zones.
